source.go_constructor_test: conduit/llm/transformer/doubao/outbound_test.go::TestNewOutboundTransformer (case 'base URL with trailing slash') + TestNewOutboundTransformerWithConfig (case 'valid config with trailing slash')
source.note: Captures Doubao's trailing-slash normalization. The Go constructor test feeds baseURL 'https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/' (trailing slash) and asserts the transformer's BaseURL is normalized to 'https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3' (slash stripped). The TransformRequest case 'base URL with trailing slash' then feeds a minimal chat request through that transformer and asserts req.URL=='https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/chat/completions' (no double slash). selected_channel, upstream_http and client_http are null (outbound-only unit test).

unified_request._comment: Exact llm.Request literal from the Go test 'base URL with trailing slash' fixture (same minimal chat request).

outbound_http._comment: Asserted by the Go test 'base URL with trailing slash': the transformer is constructed with baseURL 'https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/' (trailing slash) and TransformRequest produces req.URL=='https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/chat/completions' (slash normalized away). Only the URL assertion is made by this case (the validate callback is URL-only); Auth/Method/Content-Type are the same as chat_completion_basic since the same transformer logic applies.
